title: Learning the Macroeconomic Language
abstract: arXiv:2512.21031v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We show how state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) can be trained effectively on limited historical data for macroeconomic forecasting. We estimate a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with stochastic volatility and Student-t shocks on an initial segment of the data to obtain a posterior distribution over structural parameters. We sample from this posterior to generate millions of theory-consistent synthetic panels that, when mixed with macroeconomic data, form the training corpus for a deep learning transformer. Rather than using the DSGE model as a direct forecasting device, we use it as a structural simulator that regularizes transformer training in a small-sample environment. Our results show that this hybrid forecaster, which combines the theoretical coherence of DSGE models with the representational power of modern LLMs, learns key features of the macroeconomic language. Relative to a conventional vector

translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.21031v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：我们展示了如何在有限的宏观经济历史数据上有效训练最先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）以进行宏观经济预测。我们在数据的初始段上估计了一个具有随机波动率和Student-t冲击的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，以获得结构参数的后验分布。我们从该后验分布中采样，生成数百万个理论一致的合成面板数据，这些数据与宏观经济数据混合后，构成深度学习变换器的训练语料库。我们并非将DSGE模型直接用作预测工具，而是将其作为结构模拟器，在小样本环境中规范变换器的训练。我们的结果表明，这种混合预测器结合了DSGE模型的理论一致性与现代LLMs的表征能力，能够学习宏观经济语言的关键特征。相对于传统的向量自回归模型，它表现出更优的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种混合预测方法，利用DSGE模型生成合成数据来正则化大型语言模型的训练，在有限数据下实现更优的宏观经济预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid forecasting approach that uses DSGE-generated synthetic data to regularize LLM training, achieving superior macroeconomic predictions with limited data.
